sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ip.market_ticker, ip.period_reward_usd AS rwd, ip.target_size, ip.end_date, ip.id AS rid FROM incentive_programs ip WHERE ip.superseded_at IS NULL AND ip.disappeared_at IS NULL AND ip.status_observed = 'active' AND ip.incentive_type = 'liquidity' AND ip.end_date > now()), s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ms.market_ticker) ms.market_ticker, ms.best_yes_bid, ms.best_no_bid, ms.yes_depth_at_best AS yd, ms.no_depth_at_best AS nd FROM incentive_market_snapshots ms WHERE ms.at > now() - interval '30 minutes' AND ms.book_valid ORDER BY ms.market_ticker, ms.at DESC) SELECT p.market_ticker AS mkt, p.rwd::text AS reward_period, least(p.best,25) AS px_cap, s.yd::int AS yes_depth, s.nd::int AS no_depth, round((p.rwd / greatest(extract(epoch from (p.end_date - now()))/86400.0, 0.01))::numeric, 2)::text AS rwd_per_day, round((1.0 / (1.0 + least(s.yd, s.nd)))::numeric, 6)::text AS share_qty1, round(((p.rwd / greatest(extract(epoch from (p.end_date - now()))/86400.0, 0.01)) * (1.0 / (1.0 + least(s.yd, s.nd))))::numeric, 5)::text AS our_usd_per_day FROM (SELECT p.*, least(coalesce(sx.best_yes_bid,99), coalesce(sx.best_no_bid,99)) AS best FROM p LEFT JOIN s sx ON sx.market_ticker = p.market_ticker) p JOIN s ON s.market_ticker = p.market_ticker WHERE least(s.yd, s.nd) IS NOT NULL AND least(coalesce(p.best,99),99) <= 25 ORDER BY (p.rwd / greatest(extract(epoch from (p.end_date - now()))/86400.0, 0.01)) * (1.0 / (1.0 + least(s.yd, s.nd))) DESC LIMIT 25
